rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
aura: Immortal head separated conceptually from Ketu body (rahu-c05) swallows the sun/moon in eclipse deed (c06); physically occluded disk supplies cosmic grandeur and light.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of RAHU, the immortal head in Hindu eclipse narratives, respectfully shown swallowing a heavenly disk [rahu-c05,rahu-c06].
ANATOMY: EXACTLY ONE IMMORTAL HUMANLIKE HEAD with TWO eyes, nose, mouth, dignified ancient mature face and dark hair. Rahu is the head, the body belongs to Ketu [rahu-c05], so NO torso, shoulders, arms, hands, legs, snake body or second head. Clean non-gory presentation: lower chin/beard dissolves into deep natural shadow/cloud obscuration; no severing event, cut neck, blood or wound. No added third eye, horns, animal head, modern monster design or magical crown. The head is the clear huge cosmic subject, not a decorative disembodied ornament.
MOMENT: Rahu tips his face downward toward the low viewer and closes his enormous mouth around HALF OF THE SUN DISK; a clearly round remaining half of the sun protrudes at the mouth, with its edge visibly physically occluded by lip and normal teeth. One sun only, no moon. Both eyes stare down as the daylight is eclipsed, darkness behind.
POWER: physically swallowing the SUN to cause its eclipse is explicitly documented [rahu-c06]. Make occultation unambiguous through overlap at the mouth, not by showing a moon hovering in front of an unrelated head. No fire breath, beam or invented solar destruction.
SCALE & CAMERA: close extremely low cosmic-head perspective, face and open mouth fill square, both eyes and mouth read at 200px; head outline remains inside frame. Domain event gives cosmic grandeur, not an ordinary person portrait. LIGHT: the swallowed disk is sole dominant physical source, deep walnut-black sky, low aged-gold facial highlights; painterly realistic facial textures and natural dark clouds, no luminous fog. SETTING: sky during eclipse from documented eclipse deed [rahu-c06]. MOOD: overwhelmingly awe-inspiring and fierce divine celestial agency, respect Hindu living tradition; no horror mutilation, gore or mockery. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, scripts, logos, frame, border, watermark, signature, body/limbs, gore, bleeding cut, snake tail, extra heads or eyes, generic aura, energy ribbons, neon or film/game/anime/comic copying. Render original mythic interpretation.
